pages.text: The crab Hera sent to help the Hydra: small but vicious. Sits on the bank of its lair. In the myth it pinched Heracles by the heel, so he beat the Hydra only with Iolaus.
Abilities: its pinch holds you in place, its shell halves arrows. How to beat: Heracles crushed it under his foot. A jump attack does double damage. Drops a claw.
